page.layout: One printed page: running head at top with page number at top right; chapter heading and title centred; then one main text column of body text; marginal notes in the left margin (year numbers and small notes) and right margin (side notes); a catchword line at the foot of the column.

main_text.head: CAPUT VIII.
DE CONSTANTINO VI & IRENE.
Anno imperii, ad A.C. 790. inclusive.
main_text.p: Res CONSTANTINI & IRENES optimes Constantinus. [illegible, ~12 letters] [illegible, ~10 letters] expuli pulsant Ann. Dom. 790. [illegible, ~20 letters] me [illegible, ~8 letters], polliquoes [illegible, ~6 letters] 790 Eleutherium patricio, quod exstruxerat, liberaliter fuboci pulsisse; in Bulgarium pontifi merit in Cilicium castra Saracenos, qui uiroloque eventu, movit. Nam ibi aliquot locorum in praelio hic, cum aquilonis hostes numerum invenerat, Constantinopolim redire 791 pollinem mature & optimorum praefecturum rius, eandem in finiteratem imperii restituit, & exercitus in eius verba adegit, & in subiga- rem magna ipse victoria mavit, (deo favoris a- gente) ut ordines, grandium opportunitate jactatur frumento vix tuga classis est. Athenes ela- de superdictae. Anguillo te exaltis exhibuerunt, Nicephorum, quaedam Patrum, Anguillanae appellaverit. Constantinus, re confusio, oculis eosdem privavit, Christophoro & Nice- cetas eriam linguam abscidit. Sualo id ma- tris factum, quae exstrum subditis filium red- Kcc4 de-
